notes: Feishu-onboarding fixes from the first real field report. A channel-only install (no Telegram token + at least one enabled non-TG channel) now starts: one shared judgment serves the service's startup gate, the constructor and run_service.sh --check, the getUpdates leg and the bot menu are skipped, every other leg runs normally, and the historical fail-closed refusal stands whenever nothing is configured — so a Feishu-only box no longer needs a local patch (and no longer blocks upgrades). Model-endpoint reachability stops lying: the probe tries the base as-is first (Zhipu is /api/paas/v4, not /v1), treats a keyless 401 or 404 as an answered endpoint while keeping 5xx and connection failures red, probes loopback directly instead of through any shell proxy, and falls back to a TCP check on the real host instead of 127.0.0.1. Copy honesty: the site and both READMEs now describe the anonymous usage ledger as opt-in and off by default — matching the code — next to the documentation-only statement that aidog.im is this documentation site. Docs: the Feishu inbound requirements verified live (history permission, published version, bot in the chat, never allow the bot's own cli_ sender), the WSL-native clone rules (chmod-hostile mounts, CRLF on copied scripts) and the optional OpenAI-shaped gateway. Quality: core 2471/2471, console smoke 557/557, setup wizard 123/123, locale packs 1544 per pack, publish gate READY, E2E batch green (36 scripts plus the two known helpers).
